items.source: Activates when there is a bean of type DataSource configured in the context, the Spring Data JPA JpaRepository type is on the classpath, and there is no other, existing JpaRepository configured.
items.translation: 当上下文中配置了类型为DataSource的 Bean，Spring Data JPA 的JpaRepository类型位于类路径中，且没有其他已存在的JpaRepository配置时，会激活此功能。

items.source: In case EnableEnversRepositories is on the classpath, EnversRevisionRepositoryFactoryBean is used instead of JpaRepositoryFactoryBean to support RevisionRepository with Hibernate Envers.
items.translation: 如果 EnableEnversRepositories 在类路径中，则使用 EnversRevisionRepositoryFactoryBean 而不是 JpaRepositoryFactoryBean 来支持带有 Hibernate Envers 的 RevisionRepository。

items.source: Once in effect, the auto-configuration is the equivalent of enabling JPA repositories using the @EnableJpaRepositories annotation.
items.translation: 一旦生效，自动配置等同于使用 @EnableJpaRepositories 注解启用 JPA 仓库。

items.source: This configuration class will activate after the Hibernate auto-configuration.
items.translation: 此配置类将在 Hibernate 自动配置之后激活。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Josh Long, Scott Frederick, Stefano Cordio
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Josh Long, Scott Frederick, Stefano Cordio
